column3: S-Sorry, it surprised me... It seems like I got a bit confused.
It seems like you're fine now.
So... Hm... Manami, you're worried about my popularity?
Don't "Yes" me! You're supposed to interject here!
You are! You should say something like "Kyou-chan, popular? I've never seen such a thing!"
That being said, I'd prefer if she didn't say something like that.
But if this nosy granny saw me getting too intimate with girls, she'd give me a lecture or two.
Because you're concerned about me, you asked me to become your boyfriend right?
Indeed, if I got myself a girlfriend, I wouldn't get those weird thoughts of the other girls anymore...
As for her, diminishing the source of her worries might ease her, won't it?
I might also be able to clear up that whole "Evil brother trying to get his hands on his little sister's friends" misunderstanding.
T-That's not it! It's just that, since you said it so casually... I was a bit surprised...
It's not like these feelings are a lie.
Me liking Manami is a fact. However, a relationship is a completely different matter.
Akagi mentioned it before, but at that time, I assumed he was fooling around and shrugged it off.
But now that I think about it, how's that?
Going to school together, studying together on days off..
For highschoolers, isn't that what you'd call dating?
And then, this situation. Considering the current flow; this is it, I'm being confessed to. And without realizing it, I stubbornly decided to play dumb.
It's a disgrace for a man to do such a thoughtless thing to his long-time childhood friend.
What's that, aren't you the one who asked for it?
I'm not a beauty like Kirino, nor am I cute like Ayase...
Kirino's my little sister. And again Ayase?!
But well, didn't you ask me out in order to clear up that misunderstanding with them?
How much... do you love me?
Huh?  What's this all of a sudden?
F-For example, the "wanting to be together every day" kind of love...
Or the kind of love where you want to go on dates, or think about marriage...
In one word, that would be... 【engagement】?
As expected, this is going too far!
I imagine things several years in the future. Until now, Manami was only my neighbor.
The warm and comforting conversations we've always had, I could only think will continue as always.
And it's not something I didn't want. Rather, it was a comfortable feeling. That way of life, it feels as if it'll continue forever...
If so, getting engaged is not necessarily a mistake...
From now on I'm... Kyou-chan's girlfriend... right?
Say, it's not much but... I have a request.
Hm?  What is it this time?
Life counseling... As a continuation of that...
Where have I heard that phrase before...
Can we hold hands? Only a little is fine so...
A-Aah. I don't mind... It's no big deal...
We've held hands before as kids, haven't we? Why are you even thanking me?
Fufufu. Well, I'll forgive you for the way you're holding onto that.
Well... It seems that the cozy relationship we had is going to change a bit starting tomorrow.
Manami's life counseling was somehow different from my sister's. It wasn't an ordeal. Rather, it was more like a kind and open-hearted conversation.
While I was thinking about it, Manami and I were walking side by side.
Why is she here...? She was even all excited about going to that Meruru event in Akiba.
Oh well, she's just like always.
Hey, Manami? What's is it, all of a sudden?!
Huh? What is it! Or rather, don't chase after me!
I have something...! To tell you! Please...! Hear me out...!
I don't want to hear it! I'm going somewhere! I'm busy!
W-Why are they...! Talking...! And running at the same time...!?
I told you... I don't care, didn't I!?
Ahh...ahh... W-Wait, Kirino, why are you in such a bad mood?
Shut up! I'm going already! If I don't hurry... I'm going to miss the event!
As she started running, in front of Kirino, a car...
What...? Whoooooa?! It's true, how did I do that?! I thought that Kirino was in danger and my body moved on its own...
Manami, that's the first time in my life I've seen you act so fast.
I don't understand, I couldn't think straight.
Unbelievable, is this the blazing power of stupidity!? I don't know but, as expected of a granny...!!
Is that so～ That's a relief～
Ah, ahaha. It looks like it's scratched. But it's shallow, so it's fine～
More importantly, I'm glad that nothing happened to you～
Yes. I'll clean the wound and put a band-aid on it. It stopped hurting already.
As she said so, she showed off the band-aid she put on her knee.
If that's the case, then it's alright. Kirino, don't you have something to say?
What's with that "Hmph"... You just got saved, what's with your attitude!
I... I have stuff to do in Akiba, so...
She fled when she saw that we were here. And she didn't even say thanks to Manami...
Before, when Manami came to my house to cook something and Kirino had acted displeased with everything, she still thanked her for the meal.
That place was supposed to be safe from my unyielding sister. Though this time...
Sorry, Manami. I'll talk some sense into her later.
No, I don't mind. As long as Kirino-chan is safe, that's enough!
You... Saying stuff like that will be the end of you someday.
I have a nice boyfriend now, so... He'll protect me!
